sql_templates.description: Select VCP and breakout stocks with strong fundamentals for TradingView export.
sql_templates.name: select_vcp_breakouts_with_fundamentals
sql_templates.template:
WITH recent_stocks AS (
    SELECT symbol, MAX(trade_date) AS recent_date
    FROM market.equity_eod
    WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
    GROUP BY symbol
),
latest_fundamentals AS (
    SELECT symbol, fundamental_score, earnings_quality, sales_growth, financial_strength
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
    AND fundamental_score > 70
)
SELECT e.symbol, e.high, e.close, f.fundamental_score
FROM market.equity_eod e
JOIN recent_stocks r ON e.symbol = r.symbol AND e.trade_date = r.recent_date
JOIN latest_fundamentals f ON e.symbol = f.symbol
WHERE e.high = e.week52_high
OR e.symbol IN (SELECT symbol FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks WHERE vcp_score > 70)
ORDER BY e.trade_date DESC, f.fundamental_score DESC
